summary: Unified search across all indexed Tangled documents.
details: Delegates to keyword search. The mode parameter is accepted but only "keyword" is supported.

queryParams.name: q
queryParams.description: Search query. Supports boolean operators, phrases, and prefix matching.

queryParams.name: type
queryParams.description: Filter by record type: repo, issue, pull, profile, string.

queryParams.name: author
queryParams.description: Filter by author handle or DID.

queryParams.name: state
queryParams.description: Filter by state: open, closed, merged.

summary: FTS5 keyword search over indexed Tangled documents.
details: Same parameters and response shape as GET /search. Use this route to bypass mode negotiation.

queryParams.name: q
queryParams.description: Search query. Supports boolean operators, phrases, and prefix matching.

queryParams.name: type
queryParams.description: Filter by record type: repo, issue, pull, profile, string.

queryParams.name: author
queryParams.description: Filter by author handle or DID.

queryParams.name: state
queryParams.description: Filter by state: open, closed, merged.

summary: Fetch a single indexed document by its stable ID.
details: The document ID has the format did|collection|rkey. Deleted documents return 404.

summary: Tangled actor profile with optional Bluesky social data.
details: Resolves handle to DID, fetches sh.tangled.actor.profile from the actor's PDS. If the profile record has bluesky:true, Bluesky display name and avatar are also returned.

summary: List all sh.tangled.repo records for an actor.
Repo record with resolved knot host and AT URI.
Directory tree for a ref, proxied from the actor's knot.

queryParams.name: ref
queryParams.description: Branch, tag, or commit SHA. Defaults to default branch.

summary: File contents at a path and ref, proxied from the actor's knot.
Commit log for a ref, proxied from the actor's knot (raw bytes).

queryParams.name: path
queryParams.description: Limit log to commits touching this path.

queryParams.name: cursor
queryParams.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

summary: Branch list for a repo, proxied from the actor's knot (raw bytes).
Default branch name for a repo, proxied from the actor's knot.
Language breakdown for a repo at a ref, proxied from the actor's knot.
Tag list for a repo, proxied from the actor's knot (raw bytes).
Diff for a ref, proxied from the actor's knot (raw bytes).

queryParams.name: ref
queryParams.description: Commit SHA or branch to diff.

summary: Comparison between two refs, proxied from the actor's knot (raw bytes).
Issues scoped to a repo, pre-joined with state (open/closed).
Pull requests targeting a repo, pre-joined with status (open/closed/merged).
All issues authored by an actor, pre-joined with state.
All pull requests authored by an actor, pre-joined with status.
sh.tangled.graph.follow records for an actor.
sh.tangled.string records posted by an actor.
Single issue with pre-joined state (open/closed).
details: State is derived from sh.tangled.repo.issue.state records. If no state record exists the issue is considered open.

summary: All comments for a specific issue.
details: Filters sh.tangled.repo.issue.comment records from the actor's PDS by matching the issue AT URI.

pathParams.name: rkey
pathParams.description: Record key of the parent issue.

summary: Single pull request with pre-joined status (open/closed/merged).
details: Status is derived from sh.tangled.repo.pull.status records. If no status record exists the PR is considered open.

pathParams.name: rkey
pathParams.description: Record key of the pull request.

summary: All comments for a specific pull request.
details: Filters sh.tangled.repo.pull.comment records from the actor's PDS by matching the pull AT URI.

pathParams.name: rkey
pathParams.description: Record key of the parent pull request.

summary: Resolve a handle to a DID via bsky.social.
details: Proxies com.atproto.identity.resolveHandle. The response shape mirrors the ATProto lexicon.

queryParams.name: handle
queryParams.description: Tangled or ATProto handle to resolve.

summary: Fetch a DID document for did:plc or did:web identifiers.
details: did:plc resolves via plc.directory. did:web resolves via https://{host}/.well-known/did.json. Other DID methods return 400.

summary: Paginated list of recent ATProto events from the Jetstream cache.
details: Events are cached as the Jetstream firehose is consumed. Only Tangled-relevant collections are retained by default.

queryParams.name: operation
queryParams.description: Filter by operation: create, update, delete.

summary: WebSocket proxy to the Bluesky Jetstream firehose.
details: Accepts a WebSocket upgrade and forwards all query parameters to jetstream2.us-east.bsky.network. Standard Jetstream params: wantedCollections, wantedDids, cursor.

summary: Social summary for an actor: follower count via Constellation.
details: Best-effort — if Constellation is unavailable follower_count is 0 rather than an error.

summary: Constellation backlinks count for any subject/source pair.
details: Used by the mobile client for star counts (source: sh.tangled.graph.star) and follower counts (source: sh.tangled.graph.follow).

queryParams.name: subject
queryParams.description: AT URI or DID being linked to.

queryParams.name: source
queryParams.description: Collection NSID of the backlink records.

summary: Proxy a GET request to a Tangled knot's XRPC endpoint.
details: Forwards to https://{knotHost}/xrpc/{nsid} with all query parameters. knotHost must not contain slashes or whitespace.

pathParams.name: nsid
pathParams.description: XRPC NSID to call on the knot.

summary: Proxy a GET request to an ATProto PDS XRPC endpoint.
details: Forwards to https://{pds}/xrpc/{nsid} with all query parameters. pds must not contain slashes or whitespace.

pathParams.name: nsid
pathParams.description: XRPC NSID to call on the PDS.

summary: Proxy a GET request to the Bluesky public API.
details: Forwards to https://public.api.bsky.app/xrpc/{nsid}. No authentication is forwarded; only public endpoints are accessible.

pathParams.name: nsid
pathParams.description: XRPC NSID to call on the Bluesky public API.

summary: Liveness probe. Returns 200 if the process is responsive.
details: No dependency checks. Safe to call at any frequency.

summary: Readiness probe. Checks database reachability.
details: Executes a test query against the Turso/SQLite database. Returns 503 if the database cannot be reached.
